verdict.rationale: The only DNSSEC-related evidence is the RDAP record for Namecheap's own domain, namecheap.com, which shows it is signed and has DS data at the registry. That shows one domain is signed; it does not document a customer-facing one-click or API-driven DNSSEC signing feature. The listed Go SDK methods, Terraform provider docs and knowledgebase articles never mention DNSSEC signing or DS record management, so the evidence does not show Namecheap delivers this story.

support.subject: As a security engineer, DNSSEC is supported and easy — one-click or API-driven signing with the DS records handled at the registry
